title: cassiope fastigiata

It is native to high-altitude mountainous regions and is prized for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Cassiope fastigiata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress.
